aToB.memory: Whenever Prof. Marlowe runs volatile planar distillation rigs in the Potions & Alchemy Lab, she sends for Soren to inspect and reinforce the containment barrier runes. He values how clearly she states exact mana tolerances without wasted flourishes—and noticing how often her lab lights burn past midnight, he has left a dense dark rye loaf near her office door once or twice.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Soren wants to check the containment rim around Prof. Marlowe's primary workbench in the Potions & Alchemy Lab and report concisely that the silver-wire anchors held steady without hairline drift.

bToA.memory: Evelyn trusts Soren Lindqvist's quiet hands in the Potions & Alchemy Lab because he never tries to lecture her on Dimensional Theory—he simply cuts containment runes that hold cleanly to three decimal places. She also strongly suspects the unusually fine dark rye loaves left outside her office after marathon late nights originate from Mooncrest's stoic apprentice.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Evelyn wants to ask Soren smoothly in the Potions & Alchemy Lab to run a quick calibration sweep on her workbench barriers—and quietly thank him for the mysteriously fresh rye bread keeping her late-night research civilized.
